derivation_chain.assumption: E[p]|_{G_{Q_p}} reducible; C ≅ Z/p stable; σ(P) = λ(σ)P on a generator P of C

steps.why: the x-coordinate is invariant under negation on any Weierstrass model
steps.hypothesis: none — this holds for every point on every such model

steps.step: x(P) ∈ Q_p  <=>  σ(P) = ±P for all σ
steps.why: Galois fixes x(P) exactly when it moves P to a point with the same x-coordinate, and the only such points are ±P
steps.hypothesis: p ODD. At p = 2 every P satisfies P = -P, so the right side is vacuously true and the equivalence carries no information

steps.why: λ is defined by σ(P) = λ(σ)P on the generator P of C
steps.hypothesis: C is Galois-stable and cyclic of order p

steps.step: λ² = 1  <=>  ker φ's kernel polynomial has a Q_p-linear factor
steps.why: `04`'s boxed statement, assembled from the four above
steps.hypothesis: E[p]|_{G_Q_p} REDUCIBLE — without a stable line there is no λ

derivation_chain.the_box: FW17-H2 FAIL <=> phi or dual(phi)'s kernel polynomial has a Q_p-linear factor

p_odd_is_load_bearing.so_at_p_2: every P in E[2] satisfies P = -P
p_odd_is_load_bearing.the_clause_becomes: sigma(P) = ±P holds for every sigma with no Galois input, so the criterion would report lambda^2 = 1 unconditionally
p_odd_is_load_bearing.and_at_odd_p: P has order p > 2, so P != -P and the clause genuinely constrains sigma

cyclotomic_order.why_surjective: Q_p(zeta_p)/Q_p is totally ramified of degree p - 1, so omega's image is all of (Z/p)^*

mutual_exclusivity.argument: lambda * mu = omega (Weil pairing / det E[p] = omega); lambda^2 = mu^2 = 1 => (lambda*mu)^2 = omega^2 = 1
mutual_exclusivity.so: at every odd p >= 5, at most one of phi and dual(phi) has a Q_p-linear factor. `04`'s 'one isogeny + dual is enough' is tight in a stronger sense than it states: the second test is only ever consulted after the first fails, and the two can never both confirm
mutual_exclusivity.at_p_3: both CAN hold — (Z/3)^* = {1, 2} and 1^2 = 2^2 = 1 mod 3, so omega^2 = 1 there
mutual_exclusivity.not_claimed: this constrains the two tests' JOINT behaviour. It does not decide either one, and does not tell you whether FW17-H2 fails

precondition.what_RUN_036_gives: GLOBAL surjectivity at 38 primes, hence global irreducibility
precondition.why: a globally surjective representation restricts to a decomposition group at p that may well be reducible — that is the ordinary case. The global certificate is about a different group

rows.what_happens: the original E[p] has only ONE stable line, and the quotient constituent shows up in the DUAL's kernel
rows.consequence: phi catches the sub, dual(phi) catches the quotient

rows.what_happens: both Jordan-Holder constituents are already lines in E[p]
rows.consequence: phi and dual(phi) catch them directly

rows.what_happens: no enumeration of all local p-isogenies is needed
rows.consequence: two tests suffice, and by mutual_exclusivity at p >= 5 they never both fire

three_cases.and_this_round_adds: the two are mutually exclusive at p >= 5, which `04` does not state

what_it_would_cost.the_honest_statement: the kernel polynomial itself is small — degree (q-1)/2. FINDING it means locating a Galois-stable line, i.e. factoring the q-division polynomial of degree (q^2-1)/2 over Q_q. Neither is attempted here, and the precondition is undecided anyway

citation_history.the_finding: `04` is the instrument RUN-052 recorded as missing. It was in the corpus the whole time, named in one earlier report, and the v0.3 procedure that needed it does not cite it

headline: `04`'s chain checks out step by step, and `p` odd is load-bearing at step 2 — at p = 2 every point is its own negative and the clause carries no information. The consequence `04` does not state: lambda*mu = omega, so both tests firing forces omega^2 = 1, which over 46 primes happens at exactly [2, 3] — so AT EVERY p >= 5 THE TWO TESTS ARE MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE. That is (p-1)|2 again, reached from a different document than RUN-046's. The criterion is NOT run on the family: its precondition is local reducibility, RUN-036's global surjectivity does not decide it, and reading it as if it did would be `00` §6's forbidden substitution one level down
